_flow_.description: Composite generative execution flow for transforming provenance-qualified academic Field state into structured lecturable Agenda state through Field-to-Stem, Stem-to-Syllabus, and Syllabus-to-Agenda reasoning.

process.instruction: Resolve the selected BSD and its provenance-qualified academic Fields from bsd2field_generated.json. Use field_selector as an optional fine-grained alignment focus within the resolved BSD scope.

Reason from the resolved academic Field structure and available RAG to generate curriculum-ready knowledge Stems. Treat Stems as major knowledge structures rather than isolated topics, tools, techniques, products, activities, or implementation details. Preserve Field-to-Stem lineage.

Reconcile generated Stems across the active Field scope by resolving unnecessary duplication and overlap while preserving meaningful disciplinary distinctions, dependencies, and interdisciplinary relationships.

Transform the reconciled Stem structure into a coherent Syllabus according to _field2agenda_context_. Derive learning objectives, curriculum depth, knowledge dependencies, sequencing, and instructional organization from the Stem state rather than mechanically mapping individual Stems to individual course units.

Transform the Syllabus into a lecturable Agenda according to the educational context and weeks_length_setting declared by _field2agenda_context_. Organize the curriculum into coherent instructional weeks or sessions with explicit learning intent, knowledge focus, progression, research or project activity where appropriate, and expected learning outcomes.

Validate structural continuity from Field through Stem and Syllabus to Agenda, conformity with the active instructional context and configured course length, and preservation of upstream semantic lineage.
Materialize the generated Stem, Syllabus, and Agenda states as structured JSON for downstream instructional generation.
